fusions.name: Troop Tide
fusions.desc: Slams the ground in a wave that deals 14 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocks them back 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises +8% per ally within 5 tiles (max +32%).

fusions.name: Long-Arm Flick
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt of water into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage. It then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Frees you and every ally within 5 tiles from up to 2 control conditions each.

fusions.name: Shoal Closes Ranks
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 35%, a shield worth 20% of your maximum health covers you for 5 seconds and a shoal escort fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds. Once every 30 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
